rules.h1: text-5xl sm:text-6xl lg:text-7xl font-semibold tracking-tighter leading-none

typography.install_instructions: Load Clash Display, IBM Plex Sans, and JetBrains Mono from Google Fonts or Fontshare.

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Grid Borders ('The Technical Look'). Expose the skeleton, use visible 1px borders to separate content zones instead of relying only on whitespace.
spacing_and_layout.grid_system: Bento grids with gap-0 (using border-collapse techniques or border-r/border-b on items) to feel like a dashboard/IDE.
spacing_and_layout.radius: rounded-none or max rounded-sm (2px to 4px) - completely sharp, anti-soft UI.

header.style: Solid background #050505, 1px bottom border #1A1A1A. z-50 sticky. No glassmorphism.
header.logo: Text 'Orchitek' in Clash Display, bold, white, with a Signal Orange dot.

hero.layout: Left-aligned content, massive text, tight tracking. Right side features an abstract tech visual or a code snippet graphic.
hero.background: Use abstract network image heavily darkened, or keep pure #050505 with a subtle grain texture.

features_curriculum.layout: Dense 'Control Room' grid. Topics listed with JetBrains Mono numbers (01, 02, etc.). Accordion for detailed syllabus.

cards_and_pricing.style: Flat background (#0C0C0C), 1px subtle border (#1A1A1A). Hover state: border color darkens to #333333, button turns Signal Orange.
cards_and_pricing.pricing_accent: Highlight 'Student Discount' with a JetBrains Mono overline and a sharp Electric Blue or Orange badge.

buttons.primary: Sharp corners (rounded-none), bg-[#FF4400], text-white, hover:bg-[#FF6A33] transition-colors, font-medium, px-6 py-3.
buttons.secondary: border border-[#333333] bg-transparent text-white hover:bg-[#1A1A1A] px-6 py-3.

whatsapp_float.style: fixed bottom-6 right-6 bg-[#25D366] text-black p-4 rounded-none shadow-[4px_4px_0_0_#ffffff] hover:translate-y-1 hover:shadow-[2px_2px_0_0_#ffffff] transition-all z-50 flex items-center gap-2 font-mono text-sm uppercase font-bold

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Crisp and instant. No sluggish fades. Transform translate-y-[-2px] with a sharp shadow for cards.
motion_and_interactions.reveal: Staggered fade-up for list items (Curriculum) using Framer Motion.
motion_and_interactions.marquee: Use a slow-moving 'Editorial Ribbon' of tech stack names (Android Studio, Kotlin, Firebase, Google Cloud) separated by a colored slash or dot, low contrast (#333 on #050505 bg) to add texture.

hero_background.description: Abstract red/orange neon data network. Use behind the hero section with a bg-black/80 overlay.

tech_coding.description: Close up of mobile app code. Use for 'What you'll build / Features' section.

instructor_or_programmer.description: Silhouette of a programmer coding. Use alongside the 'Industry-level coding & architecture' content block.

instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL: Do NOT use Inter, Roboto, or generic fonts for headings. Use Clash Display. Fallback to a geometric sans if needed, but not Inter.
CRITICAL: Do NOT use purple (#9D4CDD) or teal (#1B93A4). Stick strictly to the Void Black, White, and Signal Orange palette.
Layout Musts: Implement the bento box grid style for 'Features' and 'Particulars' sections, utilizing 1px visible borders (border-[#1A1A1A]).
Accessibility: Ensure text over the abstract hero image has sufficient contrast (use text-shadow or heavy overlay bg-black/80).

Component Rules: Custom HTML/Tailwind for structural layout (marketing page rules), use Shadcn UI customized without the 'Vercel look' (remove soft shadows, use sharp corners) for the Enrollment form.
Forms: Include an enrollment form with inputs for Name, Email, Phone, and a Select for Schedule (Weekday/Weekend), ending with a 'Pay with Razorpay' submit button.
Icons: Use @phosphor-icons/react or lucide-react. Keep stroke width sharp (1.5 or 2).
Testing: Add data-testid attributes to all interactive elements (buttons, forms, links) using kebab-case role-based names.
